title: Common frontmatter
description: Fields every context file's YAML frontmatter carries. Composed into every type-specific schema via allOf.

fictional.description: Every corpus file is fictional. CI (no-real-data) fails on any file missing this.

mutability.description: canonical: replaced and versioned through PR review. accumulating: append-only; never rewritten, superseded not deleted.

schema_version.description: Semver of the schema this file was authored against. Loader accepts same MAJOR and MINOR <= current.
